title: Finite product average by last coordinate
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $m\in\mathbb N$, and let $f:\Omega^{m+1}\to\mathbb R$. The uniform average of $f$ over all $(m+1)$-tuples equals the uniform average over the first $m$ entries of the uniform average over the last entry.
